text:
Saturday’s reports suggest that Bayern Munich could dive into the January transfer market following an injury and surgery for Ballon d’Or winner Harry Kane, and that the Milan-linked Nicolo Tresoldi is among the options for the Bavarians.
Report: Bayern interested in Tresoldi after Kane injury
Kane is expected to miss around three months of action after undergoing surgery on his ankle on Friday, and with injuries to Luis Diaz, Serge Gnabry and a minor knock for Michael Olise, the Bundesliga giants have been left short on options in attack.
According to reports from BILD just a few days ago, Bayern were not expected to make any significant moves during the January transfer window unless any new issues arose. The situation has changed since then, though, and Fabrizio Romano suggests that Bayern “will have to consider the possibility to move in the January transfer window.”
According to reports from Calciomercato.com, Bayern will be on the lookout for a striker who is capable of covering out wide if required.
Saturday’s report claims that Club Brugge’s Nicolo Tresoldi is among those options and that Bayern have been monitoring the 22-year-old’s progress in recent weeks. Bayern are also said to be fond of Bournemouth’s Eli Junior Kroupi, who, however, could cost somewhere in the region of €80m. A more affordable option could be Monaco’s Paris Brunner, whose price tag reportedly stands at around €20m.
Reports earlier this week claimed that Tresoldi is also an option for Milan, who are reportedly willing to invest significantly on a new attacker in the January transfer window. Tresoldi, who has 13 goals from 14 appearances across the Belgian top flight and the Champions League this season, is expected to cost around €60m.

דיווחים מצביעים על כך שבאיירן מינכן עשויה לבצע מהלכים בחלון ההעברות של ינואר בעקבות פציעה וניתוח שעבר חלוצה הארי קיין, הצפוי להיעדר כ שלושה חודשים. הקבוצה הבווארית מחפשת חיזוק התקפי שיוכל לתפקד גם באגפים.

בין השמות שעולים במועדון נמצא ניקולו טרוסולדי מקלאב ברוז', המבוקש גם במילאן ומוערך בכ-60 מיליון אירו לאחר שכבש 13 שערים ב-14 הופעות העונה. אפשרויות נוספות שנשקלות כוללות את אלי ג'וניור קרופי מבורנמות' ויקר בהרבה, או פריס ברונר ממונקו שעלותו נמוכה יותר.
